requirements_summary: Workload: in-app chat assistant (primary) + semantic search embeddings for help center and docs.
Traffic profile: steady-state 1.2k requests/min, peak bursts up to 6k req/min during releases.
Latency target: p95 generation <120ms for short-turn chat (<=256 tokens); cold-start acceptable up to 300ms.
Throughput: sustain 1.2k req/min with 99% availability; want autoscale with sub-30s ramp for bursts.
Model preference: open to Llama-3 70B quantized variants; require validated throughput/accuracy tradeoffs and fallback to smaller models under cost pressure.
State: need session affinity + KV cache support for chat context; prefix caching for embeddings reuse.
Security: VPC peering + SSO (SAML), KMS for key custody, audit log export to SIEM, per-tenant data residency controls.
Retention: vectors 30d, logs 90d; ability to extend for specific enterprise customers.
Observability: token-level cost breakdown per route; tracing for request failures and model fallbacks.
pricing_preferences: Initial committed capacity: equivalent of 3 A100-eq GPUs (baseline pool) — target $40k/month committed (12-month term)
Burst policy: up to 2x baseline capacity available for limited windows (up to 6 hours/day) billed as usage-based overage; customer asks for predictable burst modeling.
Overage tolerance: finance wants hard cap option (max 20% above committed spend/month) and pre-approval for larger overages.
Ramp schedule: Q1 operate at ~50% of commit, Q2 ramp to 100% as feature release rolls out, review at end of Q3 for expansion.
Discount structure: seasonable ramp discount tied to multi-quarter commit and annual prepay option.
SLA credits: request SLA credit schedule tied to p95 latency and availability; penalty thresholds to be included in final SOW.
Upgrade path: ability to add additional GPU-equivalent capacity within 48 hours; pricing for short-term burst packs (1-week increments) requested.
